moral: Staying calm and careful helps in every journey.

story: Captain Mira sailed slowly with her crew, planning a quiet visit to a secret island. A thick fog surrounded the ship, making it difficult to see the path ahead. Captain Mira used her skills and stayed calm to guide the ship safely through the fog. They reached the island and found a hidden box filled with food to share. Captain Mira and her crew returned home safely, happy and proud of their calm journey.
